title: Malaysian Biryani Delight
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Malaysia, this biryani recipe combines the best of spices with tender silky chicken.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tsp of malaysian biryani spice mix and sauté for 1 minute.
Add 1 lb chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add 2 cups of flour and stir to combine.
Add 1 block silk tofu and stir gently.
Pour in 1 cup of herbal tea and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped herbs.
